sections.title: Pivot retests after EMA6 crossings

sections.body: After an actual EMA6 crossing, seek the first subsequent completed three-minute bar containing the exact pivot, completed within 30 minutes or by 16:00, whichever comes first. Exclude the signal bar. Hold/failed/equal describe the retest bar's close relative to crossing direction. Touch time is resolved to a three-minute bar; no intrabar order is inferred.
sections.title: First subsequent exact-pivot touch

sections.description: Saved descriptive summaries. Filters select existing rows; counts, denominators and estimates are never recomputed in the browser.
notes: Sparse means fewer than 30 supporting distinct days. Null means unavailable; zero is observed zero. Periods and event panels overlap and cannot be added.

Touch incidence uses fully observed 30-minute windows only. Hold/failed/equal rates use all observed first touches, including an observed touch in a shorter available window; these denominators differ.
Market sections in New York time: opening_range = 09:30–10:30; new_york_am = 10:30–12:30; new_york_pm = 12:30–16:00. All combines the three sections.
